review:
A 10-line Floating Dragon sequel with fish, dragon boats and drums, keeping the series' two-bonus setup.

The Hold & Spin gives you lives that reset when coins land, with diamonds for bigger prizes; the free spins bring rising multipliers and extra spins for more scatters. Two bonuses means more variety. Up to 10,000x – but the 96.07% RTP is lower than most Floating Dragon games, so check the info screen.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
